description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This Tie-Down Kit secures the battery to the engine bay/battery compartment.
Comes with everything you need to successfully secure the battery to the engine compartment.
Secures the Battery Short ways (Clamp bracket runs short ways across the top of the battery)
Battery Width – 6 1/2″
Maximum Battery Height – 7 1/4
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Battery Tie-Down Bar
Qty 1 – Long Threaded Tie-Down Hook Rods
Qty 1 – Short Threaded Tie-Down Hook Rods
Qty 2 – Nuts & Washers for Tie-Down Hook Rods
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988 All Models
